projects.title: Pussellawa kids' trip to Hanuman Kovil
projects.summary: The children of Pussellawa spent a day at Hanuman Kovil: running and playing on the lawn, dancing together and looking out over the hills, with transport and food fully covered.
projects.quote: The children truly enjoyed the experience and were very happy.
projects.story:
## Summary

The children of Pussellawa spent a day at Hanuman Kovil, in the hills on the road between Gampola and Nuwara Eliya. They ran and played on the lawn, danced together in their best clothes, shared a meal and looked out over the mountains.

## The need

Pussellawa is a tea-country town, and many of its children grow up among the estates. Families work hard and a day away together is rare. Transport and food are what stand between these children and a day out.

## The day

On 12 October 2026 a hired vehicle took the children to Hanuman Kovil. On the big lawn they played running games, held hands in circles and danced, while the grown-ups watched over them. Some of the little ones simply stood and looked out at the mountains.

The local organisers wrote to us the same day: *"The children truly enjoyed the experience and were very happy."*

## Where the money went

Every rupee went to the day itself: Rs 10,500 for the vehicle and Rs 8,750 for food, Rs 19,250 in total.

## What it leaves behind

A day of joy the children will remember, and the first Raavanaa day in the hill country. Thank you to everyone who made it possible.

projects.title: Kids' day out at Casuarina Beach

budget.item: Van hire to Karainagar and back

projects.summary: A day at the sea for about 25 children: sand, waves, kites and a good lunch under the casuarina trees at Karainagar.
projects.story:
## Summary

A day at the sea for about 25 children: sand, waves, kites and a good lunch under the casuarina trees at Karainagar.

## The need

Many of these children live less than an hour from the sea and have never spent a day on the beach. Transport, food and a safe group are what stand between them and the shore.

## The plan

A van takes the group to Casuarina Beach in the morning. The children play games, fly kites and build sandcastles with volunteers watching the water, then share lunch in the shade before heading home with a small gift.

The project is **activated**: it is fully funded by Kiri & Family, the place is visited and the van is booked. We are now getting the volunteers ready.

## What it leaves behind

A first day at the sea that the children will remember. After the trip we will share the story and the pictures here.

expectations.text: Every child spends time in the sea, safely, with a volunteer close by

projects.title: Mums and kids, united: a day out together

budget.item: Printed family photo for each mum

projects.summary: A day out for mums and their children together: games, a shared lunch and time to simply enjoy each other.
projects.story:
## Summary

A day out for mums and their children together: games, a shared lunch and time to simply enjoy each other.

## The need

The mums we work with carry their families alone or nearly alone. Days off are rare, and days out with their children rarer still.

## The day

A bus took the families out for the day. The children and their mums played games side by side, shared a big lunch and finished with a family photo for each mum to keep.

This project is **complete**. It was made possible by Sasi, Shanker and Bala.

## What it left behind

Mums who laughed with their children all day, and a photo on the wall to remember it by.

updates.title: A day the mums said they will never forget
updates.body: Eighteen mums and thirty children spent the day together: sack races, a tug of war the mums won, and a long lunch in the shade. For many mums it was the first day in years with no work to do, only time with their children. Every family went home with a printed photo of the day.

expectations.note: No cooking or chores: lunch was served for everyone.

expectations.text: Every mum and child plays at least one game together
expectations.note: Sack races and a tug of war, mums against kids.

budget.item: Bus to the arcade and back

projects.summary: We are planning a trip to the arcade for children from an orphanage: games, lights, prizes and a day made just for them.
projects.story:
## Summary

We are planning a trip to the arcade for children from an orphanage: games, lights, prizes and a day made just for them.

## The need

Children growing up in a home rarely get a day that is only about fun. A few hours of games and little prizes is a small thing to give and a big thing to receive.

## The plan

An afternoon at the arcade where the only thing the children have to do is play, with transport, food and helpers arranged for the group.

The project has been **initiated**. We are waiting for the budget and the other details of the trip. As soon as they are ready, they will be shown on this page.

## What it leaves behind

A day the children will talk about for a long time. After the trip we will share the story and the pictures here, so that everyone who gave can see the smiles they created.

projects.title: A bowling day out for the Sivapoomi kids
projects.summary: We are arranging a day at the bowling lanes for the special-needs children of Sivapoomi: a day out to play, laugh and be cheered on.
projects.story:
## Summary

We are arranging a bowling day for the special-needs children of Sivapoomi: a day out to play, laugh and be cheered on.

## The need

A day out for a whole group of children with special needs takes transport, extra helpers and a budget, so it does not happen often. These are exactly the days a child remembers.

## The plan

A full day at the bowling lanes, where every child gets a turn and every roll gets a cheer, with transport, food and helpers arranged for the group.

The project has been **initiated**. We have requested the budget for the day and are waiting for a response. As soon as it is ready, it will be shown on this page.

## What it leaves behind

A happy memory for every child. After the day we will share the story and the pictures here, so that everyone who gave can see the smiles they created.
